verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents its own REST API, including a People GET endpoint with selectable fields and relationship data, and agent-oriented docs (llms.txt, markdown docs). An agent could therefore pull contact records for a pre-meeting brief. However, the evidence never shows endpoints for deals, email retrieval or activity history, and no MCP server is mentioned. Missing for 10: documented deals/pipeline endpoint, endpoint for reading recent emails, activity/history timeline retrieval, an official MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-built briefs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
Use the `fields` argument to request exactly the fields you need.
Include "relationships" in the `fields` query parameter to include relationship information.
